SiteCheck Extension · Live Interactive Preview

Built for Modern Web Engineering

Everything you need to audit, debug, and optimize websites before deployment.

🔐

Hardcore Secrets & CSP Audit

Scans page scripts for leaked API credentials (AWS, Stripe, GitHub, OpenAI, Google) and evaluates CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and Referrer security headers.

⚡

Core Web Vitals Diagnostics

Detects above-the-fold hero elements, flags LCP lazy-loading anti-patterns, detects unsized media CLS layout shift culprits, and identifies render-blocking scripts.

♿

WCAG 2.2 Contrast & Schema.org

Calculates text-to-background contrast ratios with W3C luminance formulas, flags touch targets < 24px, and deeply validates JSON-LD structured data.

🌲

Visual Headings Outline

Interactive tree visualization of H1 through H6 tag hierarchy. Instantly flags missing H1 tags, duplicated headings, and skipped hierarchy levels.

🔗

Link Integrity & Anchor Audit

Inspects all internal and external hyperlinks, validates generic anchor texts ("click here"), and flags broken or insecure URLs.

🔒

100% Local Privacy Guarantee

All audits run entirely inside your browser tab memory. We never operate tracking servers or transmit your code or data anywhere.
